intended_object: For a standard Young tableau T of nonempty shape μ (labels 0..|μ|-1), the cell of μ that holds the largest label |μ|-1. This cell is always a corner of μ. Inferred from the docstring and the module name (Corner).
explanation: In this library `YoungTableau μ` is a bijection `μ.cells ≃ Fin μ.card`, and `StandardYoungTableau μ` adds the condition that labels strictly increase along rows and columns. Labels run from 0, so the largest label is `μ.card - 1`. The hypothesis `0 < μ.card` is what makes that a valid element of `Fin μ.card`. The definition applies the inverse bijection to this label and coerces the resulting subtype element to `ℕ × ℕ`. That is exactly the cell carrying the largest label. Mathlib has no standard Young tableaux, so there is no more general counterpart, and the construction is already stated for an arbitrary Young diagram.
